title: Face
description: Upload a selfie and your face is transferred onto your avatar's texture.
privacy: Your photo never leaves this device: everything runs in your browser and nothing is sent to any server.
drop: Drag a photo here or choose one
formats: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 15 MB · a sharp, front-facing photo works best
cameraError: Could not access the camera. Check permissions or choose a file.
previewAlt: Uploaded photo with detected face landmarks
fitFailed: Face shape could not be fitted; only the texture is applied.

hints.noFace: No face found in the photo.
hints.multipleFaces: More than one face found; the largest one will be used.
hints.tooSmall: The face is too small in the photo; take it from closer.
hints.notFrontal: The face is not frontal; look straight at the camera.
hints.tooDark: The photo is too dark; try a brighter place.

errors.invalidType: Only JPG, PNG or WebP files are supported.
errors.tooLarge: The file exceeds the 15 MB limit.
errors.noFace: No face found in the photo. Try a different one.
errors.detectFailed: Face detection could not start. Reload the page and try again.
errors.faceMapMissing: The face mapping data is not available yet, so it cannot be applied right now.
errors.bakeFailed: Could not build the face texture.
